config_note: omlx in its default disk-backed prefix-cache configuration, with the cache ISOLATED PER LEVEL: a fresh empty --paged-ssd-cache-dir and a server restart before each concurrency level, and --hot-cache-max-size 0 passed explicitly (omlx persists CLI args to ~/.omlx/settings.json, so its documented defaults are not what you get). Verified 'SSD cache scan complete: scanned=0' at every level, so no level inherits blocks from another level, framework, model or day. Same methodology as the published Gemma-4 omlx results. 100/100 successful at c=1/2/4. Caveat: benchmark.py's 3 warmup requests reuse prompts 0-2, so each level starts 97/100 cold. An 8GB in-memory (hot-cache-only) variant was also measured and is NOT published: it breaks at c>=2 on this 28GB model, omlx's memory guard rejecting 76 prefills.
